This is a tiny sanitized alignment fixture derived from observed BT-7 alignment
patterns, not copied raw experiment data.

It exercises:

- a coupled A3/A4 find-peak style scan;
- a tilt scan used as a second-reflection/plane-flattening hint;
- a slit scan used as fine-alignment evidence;
- console-log events for manual moves, dependent A3/A4 motion, file creation,
  and a lattice/orientation state update.

The fixture is intended for workflow and review-label tests. It is not a
scientific source-data record.
